description: antigravity-router (self-hosted Antigravity gateway, all-Gemini) — Gemini 3.7 Flash (Medium) carries the high-traffic default tier, Gemini 3.7 Flash (High) codes, judges (advisor) and handles vision, Gemini 3.7 Flash (Low) explores cheaply. Requires ANTIGRAVITY_ROUTER_BASE_URL + ANTIGRAVITY_ROUTER_API_KEY environment variables.
